description: Drop low and drive a poisoned blade up under the ribs, then melt back into the scuffle.
name: Gutter Stab

description: Seed the ground with a venom-coated tripwire. The first enemy to cross it is snared and envenomed.
name: Venom Snare

description: Carve a rising crescent of shadow-steel that slices every enemy in front of you.
name: Umbral Crescent

description: Slow your heartbeat and sweat venom onto your blades. Your strikes poison and your next critical hits harder.
name: Serpent's Patience

description: A single kiss of the widow's fang to a vital spot. Envenomed targets take grievously increased damage.
name: Widow's Kiss

description: Blot out the sun with thrown steel. A storm of shadow blades falls on every enemy around you.
name: Eclipse Requiem

description: Nock two shafts and loose them in one breath. Both find the same mark before it can move.
name: Double Nock

description: Dig a thorn-lined pitfall along the game trail. The first enemy across it drops in, bleeding and held.
name: Briar Pitfall

description: Loose a shrieking spread of wind-driven splinters that shreds a cone of ground ahead.
name: Splinter Gale

description: Sound the alpha's howl. Your party fights as one pack: faster, keener, and harder to bring down.
name: Alpha Howl

description: One arrow, loosed from the edge of sight with the hawk circling above to mark the fall. It splits the sky on the way down.
name: Skysplitter Arrow

description: Signal the canopy. Ironwood shafts rain down over the marked ground, rooting and ruining everything beneath.
name: Ironwood Downpour

description: Hurl a flask of green vitriol that eats through armor and flesh alike.
name: Vitriol Flask

description: Shatter a soothing phial over an ally, wrapping their wounds in cool, knitting vapors.
name: Soothing Vapors

description: Scatter naphtha blossoms that burst into clinging fire across a patch of enemies.
name: Naphtha Bloom

description: Drink down a ferrous brew that plates the blood with iron. Damage taken is blunted and bleeding stops.
name: Ferrous Elixir

description: Decant a cask of pyre-oil onto one foe and spark it. The fire burns hotter the more it spreads.
name: Pyre Decant

description: The masterwork: acid and fire in one vintage. The blast melts armor, then the flames finish the lesson.
name: Grand Ignition
